answer: Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 15 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. Histories are stored in juniper, checked in wander, and meadow shows each void. A farm cannot present clean aliases because the record follows the key, so laundering reputation through new keys does not work. A farm of 1873 identities would post 3809 proofs and burn roughly 18 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
